transitions.reason: Records from the unversioned v2 instrument predate fail-closed resolved-tree screening, canonical harness identity, and complete runtime provenance.

Epoch 4 carries two changes. The queue half is bookkeeping and cannot move a verdict: a row the publisher withheld, or one whose instrument failure has exhausted its retries, is now settled at the harness hash that refused it instead of being handed back to every later slice. The DRIVER half can and does. measure-macos.sh held an absolute npm path captured before any era pin existed, so its unjailed control ran the era Node with the harness npm's JavaScript and recorded a package verdict for a failure that was ours. And all three drivers' npm reference arm -- the arm that decides whether a nub failure is BROKEN-UNJAILED-NUB or BROKEN-WITHOUT-JAIL-TOO -- ran undated on the harness toolchain, so a spurious npm failure exonerated nub and filed a candidate nub defect as a dead package. Only those two verdicts are reachable by either bug: both act on the unjailed control, and a record that got past it ran npm correctly. Every MINIMUM measurement therefore stands.

Epoch 5 dates the SCAFFOLD install in all three drivers. The package fetch has carried --before since F2 and the npm reference arm got it in epoch 4, but the second install -- the one that supplies the binaries a lifecycle script names -- never did, so it pulled TODAY's build tools into a tree pinned to the package's own era and the era Node could not parse them. observe-only.mjs:330 already records this exact failure and its fix; neither driver received it. THE FIX STANDS ON THAT MECHANISM ALONE. It was originally justified here by a ratio -- 178 of 282 BROKEN-WITHOUT-JAIL-TOO records carrying 'Error: Unexpected token' -- and that ratio is RETRACTED: 178 counted OCCURRENCES across every retained log while 282 counted verdict LINES, two different denominators reported as one fraction. Counted per RECORD over the 286 retained darwin logs, 'Unexpected token' appears in 16 of 128 BROKEN-WITHOUT-JAIL-TOO records (12.5%) and in 70 of 140 MINIMUM records (50%) -- four times more common where the measurement SUCCEEDED, so it is non-fatal noise and not this bug's signature. Only 6 of the first 53 epoch-5 darwin records ran a scaffold at all, so this scope is wider than the change warrants; it is left as issued rather than churned a third time on a corpus that has already absorbed two policy changes. Same scope as epoch 4 and for the same reason: the scaffold runs before the unjailed control, so only a record that failed that control can have been affected, and every MINIMUM measurement stands.
